template_lines: To this end, (author's piece) (adverb) exemplifies the importance of ...
(Author) therefore seeks to influence (type of person) into not only..., but rather to ...
example: To this end, Wiley’s piece ardently exemplifies the importance of adopting a tourist attraction to ensure the financial prosperity of Lawton and its community members (CONTENTION). Wiley therefore seeks to influence community residents into not only reconsidering their stance on tourist attractions, but rather to champion for its implementation in the immediate future (AUDIENCE GOING TO DO).
